# Model fixtures

`small.ifc` is downloaded from That Open's public engine UI resources and is used
only as a legal, small conversion/runtime fixture. That Open's engine repositories
are distributed under the MIT license; source:
`https://thatopen.github.io/engine_ui-components/resources/small.ifc`.

The generated `.frag` is produced by the pinned `@thatopen/fragments` 3.4.7 and
`web-ifc` 0.0.77 conversion service.
